hero.lead: Serving boards, platters, coasters and wine glasses in the Ocean, Mountain and Lava ranges. Choose a piece, ask to see photos of what is in stock, and pay by a secure link when you have decided.

about.name: Amanda Gratwick
about.p1: I’m Amanda Gratwick, the maker behind Outside The Lines Studio. I make serving boards, platters, coasters and wine glasses by hand, finished in one of three ranges: Ocean, Mountain or Lava.
about.p2: No two pieces match. The timber, the colour and the edges change from one piece to the next, so you can choose from what is in stock or ask me for photos first.
about.p3: [A few lines on how you started, where you work and what you enjoy most about making each piece.]

ordering.title: How ordering works
ordering.intro: Every piece is different, so you choose from photos of what is in stock.

steps.title: Choose a piece
steps.text: Browse the shop and pick the type, shape, size and range you like.

steps.title: Request photos
steps.text: Send a request and we reply with photos of the pieces in stock for that type.

steps.title: Pay by secure link
steps.text: When you have chosen, we send a secure payment link. You pay by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay.

faqs.a: Choose a piece, request photos of what is in stock, and tell us which one you would like. We then send a secure payment link and post your piece once it is paid.
Yes. Every piece is handmade, so the timber, the colours and the shape of the resin change from one to the next. The photos on the site show examples of each type.

faqs.q: How can I see what is currently in stock?
faqs.a: Use the request photos button on any product, or the one at the top of the page. Tell us the type, shape and size you want and we will send photos of what is in stock for that type of piece.

faqs.q: What is the difference between resin edges and clean edges?
faqs.a: Some pieces have resin running down the edges as well as through the middle. Others are clean all the way round, with timber edges and the resin kept to the surface. You can choose a preference when you order.

faqs.q: What are the Ocean, Mountain and Lava ranges?
faqs.a: Ocean pieces use teals and deep blues with white wave lines. Mountain pieces have layered blue ridges. Lava pieces have black resin with glowing orange veins. [Amanda to confirm which products come in which ranges.]

faqs.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
